caseName: Isaacs v. Hobbs Tie & Timber Co.
caseNameFull: Isaacs, Trustee in Bankruptcy v. Hobbs Tie & Timber Co.
attorneys: Mr. Thomas J. Reilly submitted the motion in behalf of Mr. William R. Watkins for Isaacs. No appearance for the Hobbs Tie & Timber Company.
